name: Maney Wire & Cable Inc
old_description: Helping businesses succeed by being the quickest, most efficient and professional supplier of electrical wire, cable, and related accessories
about:
Maney Wire & Cable was established on March 1, 1986, in Santa Fe Springs, California, as a wholesale distributor of electrical wire and cable. The company began by responding to customer needs and quickly expanded into a full-line wholesale distributor carrying a complete line of electrical products.

Today the company maintains an inventory of over 7,000 line items, with millions of feet of cable stocked across nine distribution centers. It supplies electrical wire, cable, accessories, and related products to the electrical, automotive, and marine markets. Value-added services include custom wire printing, stripping, bonded parallel cable assemblies, custom battery cables, and cut heat-shrink pieces.

Maney Wire & Cable serves the electrical, automotive, and marine industries, as well as the entertainment stage lighting sector. Its customers include contractors, OEMs, and maintenance operations requiring bulk wire, cable, and accessories.

The company distinguishes itself through a focus on domestic-made products, competitive pricing, and rapid fulfillment from its multi-location network. Its 2023 integration into the AZ Wire & Cable family further expanded its resources and service capabilities.
